name: MicroKit UI
summary: 49 free copy-paste microinteractions for React, CSS and Tailwind: animated buttons, hover effects, tabs and inputs.
description: A shadcn registry of 49 microinteractions for developers who want one specific interaction — a button that reveals an arrow on hover, tabs with a sliding underline, an input with an animated focus ring — without pulling in an animation library. Each has a live preview with TypeScript/JavaScript and CSS/Tailwind code; add by shadcn CLI, URL or hand-copy. MIT licensed.
contains: 49 interactions grouped Click feedback (38), Inputs (2), Navigation (9)
each component page has a live preview and TypeScript/JavaScript plus CSS/Tailwind code
installs via shadcn CLI: npx shadcn@latest add @microkit/<id> or direct URL; hand-copying supported
26 of 49 interactions need no dependencies; 23 import lucide-react
no npm package by design; MIT licensed
submit interactions through a prefilled GitHub issue
